cs.t: You’re in luck, the Asus FI32-U and M32U are 4k 144hz monitors with USBC PD and a built-in KVM. I can use several peripherals (keyboard, mouse, audio interface, webcam, and stream deck) and press a button to switch the display input (and those peripherals) between my MacBook (connected with a usb c cable) and my PC (connected with usb type A and DisplayPort) It’s a dream honestly!
